statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex sets once and put d_U=6-r_U for actual triangles U. Suppose R=226, every d_U belongs to {0,1,2,3}, exactly one triangle T has deficiency three, and exactly six triangles have deficiency two. Suppose exactly one point p of T is incident to one d1 and two d2 triangles, while each of the other two points is incident to three d1 and zero or one d2 triangle. Then both of the latter two d2 incidences are zero.
